name: spark-ds41f-1022-promotion-tp3
description: The trimmed promotion comparison the owner chose for spark-ds41f-1022 on three nodes (2026-10-22), about 13 minutes a build: model behaviour on 64 prompts at 8 streams (greedy outputs against the first arm's; it also heat-soaks the GPU), the engine grid up to eight requests, eight streams and one stream in closed loops (30 s warm-up, 180 s), real-text prefill at 32K and 131K. Its grid needs the dev-mode collective RPC.
